items.q: Can microcement be applied over existing tiles or marble?
items.a: Yes. Our system includes a specific bonding primer that allows direct application over ceramic, marble or stoneware without demolition. This reduces rubble, dust and project time.

items.q: How long does it take to dry and when can it be used?
items.a: Touch-dry is fast, but the polyurethane sealer fully cures in 24 to 72 hours depending on humidity and temperature. We give you the exact handover date at the end of the works.

items.q: Does the price include materials and labour?
items.a: Yes. Every quote is turnkey: it covers substrate preparation, materials, application and final sealing. Only travel costs are added outside the main cities.

items.q: What maintenance does a béton ciré surface need?
items.a: Minimal: clean with water and neutral soap. We recommend re-sealing with a protective varnish every 3 to 5 years in high-traffic areas.
Yes. We deliver projects in Casablanca, Rabat, Marrakech, Tangier, Agadir and across the Kingdom. A free technical visit validates the substrate and the quote.

about.title: The workshop behind the material
about.lead: AH Atelier was born from a conviction: beauty comes from the right gesture and true material.
story: Founded and led by Hamza Tagdalt, AH Atelier brings together craftsmen passionate about béton ciré and microcement. From manufacturing to application, we control the entire chain to guarantee consistent quality.
We work with demanding homeowners, architects and hospitality professionals, with the same obsession for detail and durability.
Our promise comes down to three words: Matter. Design. Durability.
